Primary request: A small border coaching settlement just above an underground customs passage. An arched stone customs doorway and ascending steps are visible at the left side. A parked wooden freight cart and tied bundles stand beside a low timber inn on the right. A modest public notice board and a provision doorway face a compact paved forecourt. Worn practical construction, sheltered trading stop, subdued amber windows.

Primary request: The entrance square of Salome, a hilltop scholarly city. The uphill approach opens into a human-scale stone square. Three distinct scholarly buildings occupy the middle distance: an austere theology school with a small bell tower, an arcane institute with a modest observation dome, and an engineering society workshop with a practical hoist and ventilation chimney. A side passage leads to an old archive entrance. Simple boarding houses and a notice board flank the square. The descending road remains visible at the near left edge. Scholarly civic life, restrained blue-green roofs, aged ivory stone and warm window lights.
